correctness.rationale: Finite irreducible symmetric generator has uniform equilibrium and strictly positive -L on mean-zero functions. Differentiating the counted-jump tilted generator twice produces variance rate mu+2<g,(-L)^+g>, equality iff exit intensity q(S) constant. The vertex-swap equality of k-cut sizes forces pairwise adjacency-row differences c_uv constant, with (N-2k)c_uv=0. If N!=2k connectedness forces K_N; at N=2k, a nonzero c_uv gives only a star or a disconnected clique-plus-isolate, leaving the star. Direct cut counts verify sufficiency. All endpoints N>=4, 1<=k<=N-1 handled; proof is infinite-family analytic. The bundled exact rational checker independently tests all connected graphs through N=6 and nine finite Markov generators.

value.rationale: For the central thermodynamic dynamical observable (number of successful moves) the result distinguishes Poissonian full-count behavior from strictly super-Poissonian long-time noise and gives a natural complete topology/filling classification valid for all connected simple networks. The isolated balanced-half-filled star is a structural many-body exception; at all other interacting fillings only complete graphs can have Poisson counts. This classification goes beyond exact finite sampling, avoids an arbitrary parameter slice and provides a reusable graph-independent criterion.
